integrity: The proof reduces the cross-covariance to same-pair and one-index-overlap moments of two degree-two U-statistic kernels and evaluates the exponential conditional projections exactly. A standalone deterministic checker reconstructs the conditional integrals with rational arithmetic and independently recomputes the covariance through independent exponential order spacings. Finite computations are supplementary to the symbolic all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact covariance and correlation are proved for iid exponential sampling only.
The Gini statistic is the unnormalized sample mean absolute difference, not the mean-normalized Gini coefficient.
The result gives a second-order joint law, not a complete joint distribution or conditional law.
General U-statistic covariance theory makes the overlap decomposition classical, so an older source could contain the same exponential specialization under different notation.
title: Exponential Gini mean difference and sample variance have an exact finite-sample correlation
